title: Timmelsjoch Experience & Pass Museum
name: Timmelsjoch Experience & Pass Museum
kurzbeschreibung: The Passmuseum Timmelsjoch at 2,509 m: bold architecture jutting over the abyss, architectural discovery trail, and border crossing into South Tyrol.
beschreibung:
Overview

The spectacular Passmuseum Timmelsjoch is perched at the crest of the Timmelsjoch pass at 2,509 metres above sea level on the national border between North Tyrol (Ötztal) and South Tyrol (Passeiertal). Serving as the architectural centrepiece of the renowned art and culture initiative Timmelsjoch Erfahrung, the futuristic structure projects over the rock face like a colossal boulder: cantilevered from the Tyrolean side, it juts out approximately 16 metres into the open air above the rugged precipice towards South Tyrol. The museum illuminates the arduous construction history of this high-alpine road pass and the millennia-old bonds linking the adjacent valleys.

Route & Requirements

This remarkable building was conceived by acclaimed South Tyrolean architect Werner Tscholl. Inside the monolithic glass-and-concrete structure, designed to evoke an ice cave, visitors journey through an atmospheric historical exhibition: archival black-and-white photographs, authentic documents, and eyewitness accounts chronicle the audacious construction of the Timmelsjoch-Hochalpenstraße between 1955 and 1959. The Passmuseum marks the crowning culmination of the five architectural stations of the "Timmelsjoch Erfahrung" along the 32-kilometre-long scenic alpine road: additional highlights include the Steg viewing walkway at the Hochgurgl toll station overlooking the Obergurgl glaciers, the walk-in wooden cube of the Schmuggler station, the Fernrohr telescope installation at the Scheiblingstein, and the Granat pavilion in Moos in Passeier.

Visit & Arrival

The Passmuseum Timmelsjoch is open daily from 07:00 to 20:00 during the operating season of the Timmelsjoch-Hochalpenstraße, generally from late May to late October. Admission to the Passmuseum and all sculpture stations along the pass is free of charge! A toll is levied for driving motorized vehicles along the high-alpine pass road. Timmelsjoch toll rates (2025/2026 season): car single trip approx. €20.00, return journey approx. €26.00, motorcycle single trip approx. €17.00. Arriving by car: via the Inntalautobahn A12, exit Ötztal, continuing along the B186 through the entire Ötztal past Sölden and Zwieselstein up to Hochgurgl and the pass summit (free parking is located directly at the museum at 2,509 m). Public transport: during high summer, the Timmelsjoch-Bus connects Obergurgl with St. Leonhard in Passeier.

Tips

The Passmuseum features step-free level access and is fully wheelchair accessible; due to the high-alpine altitude of over 2,500 metres, warm, windproof clothing is strongly recommended even in midsummer. Pair your visit with a stop at the Top Mountain Motorcycle Museum at the Hochgurgl toll station, Europe's highest motorcycle museum.
